fullPassage: Retrieval practice is a strategy of bringing information to mind by deliberately trying to recall it. Recent research in classrooms has shown that repeated testing that includes retrieval practice strengthens memory better than spending the same amount of time reviewing information you have already read does. In a recent study, one group of students read a 276-word passage on sea otters and then practiced recalling the information, a second group studied the information in four repeated 5-minute study periods, and a third group made concept maps to organize the information by linking together different ideas. The time spent studying was the same for each group. One week later, the students took a final test. Those who practiced retrieving the information had the best score on the final test. It has been proposed that trying to recall the information, as opposed to just rehearsing the information, results in the type of retrieval that is more likely to trigger reconsolidation, and this additional reconsolidation strengthens the memory.

det.korean: (A)의 practice는 명사 '연습(반복 훈련)', (B)의 practice는 명사 '관습(전통적 행동 양식)'.
det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 연습 — (B) 관습: (A)는 매일의 피아노 '연습', (B)는 동아시아의 오래된 '관습'
❌ ② 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B)는 '연습'이 아니라 '관습'
❌ ④ (A)는 '관습'이 아니라 '연습'
det.tip: practice: '연습'(반복 훈련) vs '관습'(전통적 행동). 문맥으로 구분

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "to bring something back into your mind from memory"

det.korean: recall = 떠올리다, 기억해내다 (기억으로부터 어떤 것을 머릿속으로 되가져오다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignore(무시하다): 머릿속으로 되가져오는 행위가 아님
✅ ② recall(떠올리다): 기억으로부터 되가져온다는 정의에 정확히 부합
❌ ③ forget(잊다): recall의 반의어
❌ ④ invent(발명하다): 이미 아는 것을 떠올리는 것이 아니라 새로 만드는 것이므로 부적합

questions.passage: Recent research in classrooms has shown that repeated testing that includes retrieval practice __________ (strengthen) memory better than spending the same amount of time reviewing information you have already read does.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

strengthen → ____

det.korean: 인출 연습을 포함한 반복된 테스트는 이미 읽은 정보를 다시 검토하며 같은 시간을 쓰는 것보다 기억을 더 잘 '강화한다'.
det.analysis: that절 안의 주어는 3인칭 단수 'repeated testing that includes retrieval practice'. 현재시제(has shown / does)의 일반 진술이므로 동사 strengthen은 3인칭 단수 현재형 strengthens로 변환.

questions.passage: In a recent study, one group of students read a 276-word passage on sea otters and then practiced __________ (recall) the information.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

recall → ____

det.korean: 최근 연구에서 한 집단의 학생들은 바다수달에 관한 276단어 글을 읽은 뒤 그 정보를 떠올리는 연습을 했다.
det.analysis: 동사 practice는 목적어로 동명사(-ing)를 취함 (practice + V-ing). practiced 뒤에 오는 목적어 자리이므로 recall을 동명사 recalling으로 변환.
det.tip: practice + 동명사. practiced recalling = 떠올리기를 연습했다

questions.passage: Retrieval practice is a strategy of bringing information to mind by deliberately trying to recall it. Recent research in classrooms has shown that repeated testing that includes retrieval practice strengthens memory better than spending the same amount of time reviewing information you have already read does. In a recent study, one group of students read a 276-word passage on sea otters and then practiced recalling the information, a second group studied the information in four repeated 5-minute study periods, and a third group made concept maps to organize the information by __________ together different ideas. The time spent studying was the same for each group. One week later, the students took a final test. Those who practiced retrieving the information had the best score on the final test. It has been proposed that trying to recall the information, as opposed to just rehearsing the information, results in the type of retrieval that is more likely to trigger reconsolidation, and this additional reconsolidation strengthens the memory.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 연결하기(linking). 세 번째 집단이 서로 다른 아이디어를 연결하여 정보를 조직한 행위.
det.analysis:
✅ ① linking(연결하기): linking together different ideas 원문 표현 — 3집단이 개념도로 아이디어를 연결
❌ ② bringing(가져오기): bringing information to mind는 인출 연습의 정의부 동사로, 개념도 맥락과 불일치
❌ ③ reviewing(복습하기): 이미 읽은 정보를 다시 보는 방식으로 개념도를 만드는 3번째 집단 활동과 다른 학습법
❌ ④ spending(쓰기): time spent studying 맥락의 동명사로 개념도 행위와 무관
det.tip: link together = 함께 연결하다 (개념도 만들기 핵심 행위)

questions.passage: Retrieval practice is a strategy of bringing information to mind by deliberately trying to recall it. Recent research in classrooms has shown that repeated testing that includes retrieval practice strengthens memory better than spending the same amount of time reviewing information you have already read does. In a recent study, one group of students read a 276-word passage on sea otters and then practiced recalling the information, a second group studied the information in four repeated 5-minute study periods, and a third group made concept maps to organize the information by linking together different ideas. The time spent studying was the same for each group. One week later, the students took a final test. Those who practiced retrieving the information had the best score on the final test. It has been proposed that trying to recall the information, as opposed to just rehearsing the information, results in the type of retrieval that is more likely to __________, and this additional reconsolidation strengthens the memory.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 재응고화를 촉발하다(trigger reconsolidation). 단순 암송과 달리, 떠올리기 시도가 기억 강화 메커니즘인 '재응고화를 촉발'할 가능성이 더 높다는 결론부.
det.analysis:
❌ ① rehearsing the information(정보를 암송하기): 글에서 '대조되는 덜 효과적인 방식'이므로 빈칸 위치의 의미와 반대
❌ ② reviewing the same passage(같은 지문 복습): 앞 문장에서 이미 덜 효과적이라고 제시된 방식
❌ ③ making concept maps(개념도 만들기): 세 번째 집단의 활동일 뿐 결론부의 인출 메커니즘이 아님
✅ ④ trigger reconsolidation(재응고화를 촉발하다): 떠올리기 시도가 '재응고화를 촉발'할 가능성이 더 높다는 원문 결론
det.tip: trigger reconsolidation = 재응고화를 촉발하다 (기억 강화의 메커니즘)
